fusions.name: Plate Breaker
fusions.desc: A crushing thrust that deals 14 damage, knocks the target back 2.5 tiles and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Cold Point
fusions.desc: A thrust at a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 28 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full range. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Rigid Guard
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage for 10 seconds, and your armour rises by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Unbent Haft
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 14 and your armour by 8%.
